text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Fez leads the way in taking measures to clean the city in accordance with the royal letter ordering this.
- Telecommunications ministry says cellular phones network extended to more towns.
- More than 300,000 people impoverished by the effects of drought leave the countryside every year to settle in cities.
- Amnesty International attending a book exhibition in Casablanca invited to withdraw reports accusing some countries over human rights.
- Head of electricity utility (ONE) Driss Benhima says electricity overtaxed in Morocco.
- Businessmen fear that takeover by French Lyonnaise des Eaux of water and electricity distribution in Casablanca will lead to increase of energy prices and investment costs.
